nodes.label: Plugin Architecture (Python Protocol Classes)
nodes.rationale: Uses Python Protocol classes as interfaces so contributors can extend any layer (brain, world, action, memory, observation) without modifying core engine code.

nodes.label: Engine-Owned Ownership Pattern
nodes.rationale: Backend declares all agents; Unity binds visual shells via BindToExisting. Simulation is source of truth, ticks before Unity connects, supports multiple Unity spectator clients.

nodes.label: BindToExisting Ownership Mode
nodes.rationale: BiomataAgent mode where Unity binds a visual shell to a backend-declared agent without sending a registration RPC.

nodes.label: Host-Owned Ownership Pattern
nodes.rationale: Backend starts empty; Unity owns full agent lifecycle via CreateAtRuntime. Enables procedural spawning, runtime roster changes, and zero-downtime brain hot-swap.

nodes.label: CreateAtRuntime Ownership Mode
nodes.rationale: BiomataAgent mode where Unity registers and unregisters agents dynamically, making the backend a pure execution engine.
